## Purpose and Entry Points
OpenResearch is a local-first research-agent workspace: it coordinates coding-agent sessions, isolated git worktrees, experiments, evidence, and multi-backend compute. The Rust CLI/service begins at `src/main.rs`; `orx up` is implemented through `src/commands/up.rs` and serves the bundled React dashboard in `ui/`. The main user surfaces are CLI commands under `src/commands/` and the browser UI rooted at `ui/src/main.tsx`.

## Local Service and API Boundary
The Rust process owns local state, filesystem/Git operations, agent invocation, job orchestration, and HTTP/API serving. Command dispatch is organized in `src/commands/mod.rs`; service startup and local UI hosting are centered on `src/commands/serve.rs` and `src/commands/up.rs`. The frontend communicates through its API client and query layer rather than directly accessing local resources: `ui/src/api.ts`, `ui/src/queries/client.ts`, `ui/src/queries/live.ts`.

## Projects, Experiments, and Evidence
Projects and experiment lineage are git-native local workspace concepts. Project lifecycle commands live in `src/commands/project.rs` and `src/commands/projects.rs`; local persistence/worktree-facing behavior is concentrated in `src/local/projects.rs`, `src/local/experiments.rs`, and `src/local/git.rs`. Runs capture the committed source snapshot and logs/artifacts, exposed through `src/commands/runs.rs` and `src/commands/logs.rs`; the UI presents experiment and workspace state through `ui/src/components/ExperimentOverview.tsx` and `ui/src/workspaceState.ts`.

## Agent Harnesses and Skills
Sessions can use Claude, Codex, Cursor, or OpenCode via a harness abstraction and per-session configuration. Detection and implementations reside in `src/local/harness/mod.rs`, `src/local/harness/detect.rs`, and provider files such as `src/local/harness/claude.rs` and `src/local/harness/opencode.rs`. Agent-facing research procedures are distributable skill documents in `agent-skills/`, installed via `src/commands/install_skills.rs` and managed locally through `src/local/agent_skills.rs`.

## Compute Execution Plane
A common run/compute layer dispatches immutable project snapshots to local or remote execution targets. Core selection/control paths are `src/compute.rs`, `src/commands/compute.rs`, and `src/jobs/mod.rs`. Concrete adapters isolate backend-specific submission and status semantics: `src/jobs/ssh.rs`, `src/jobs/slurm.rs`, `src/jobs/kubernetes.rs`, `src/jobs/ray.rs`, `src/jobs/huggingface.rs`, `src/jobs/modal.rs`, `src/jobs/tinker.rs`, and `src/jobs/openresearch.rs`. SSH also supports hosting the workspace service remotely through `src/commands/up_remote.rs`.

## Storage, Identity, and External Services
Default persistence is local SQLite/state storage, represented by `src/store.rs`, `src/local/native_store.rs`, and `src/local/datadir.rs`; project files remain on the user machine. OpenResearch’s service is an optional boundary for organization and managed-compute features, with client/control code in `src/client.rs`, `src/plane.rs`, and `src/remote.rs`. Other integrations include Git/GitHub, Overleaf, LaTeX, browser login/cookies, and configurable local model endpoints, under `src/local/github.rs`, `src/local/overleaf.rs`, `src/local/latex.rs`, and `src/local/local_models.rs`.

## Dashboard and Distribution
The Vite/React dashboard supplies project navigation, chat/session interaction, code and diff views, logs, settings, remote status, and compute selection. Routing is defined in `ui/src/router.tsx` and `ui/src/routes/`; principal workspace views include `ui/src/components/ChatPanel.tsx`, `ui/src/components/CodeView.tsx`, and `ui/src/components/ProjectsHome.tsx`. Rust build packaging embeds/serves the UI (`build.rs`, `ui/dist/`), while macOS app packaging uses `scripts/package-macos-app.sh` and `macos/`.
